verdict.rationale: The webhook docs cover both halves of the story: every webhook carries a `webhook-id` header that the docs say to use as an idempotency key for deduplicating retries, and webhook signing is available, though it is opt-in per account. Missing for 10: details of the signature scheme and verification procedure (algorithm, headers, secret handling), documentation of the retry or replay-window behaviour, and independent or hands-on corroboration that signing and dedup work as described.
